inspection.scope: Nonlinear scalar geometry, full displayed top sector and explicit UV anomaly/completion caveat.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

SU5/SO5 is a nonlinear sigma target, not a gauged SU5. Gauged subgroup is [SU2 x U1]^2 plus colour. Goldstones include H doublet and complex weak triplet; eaten singlet/triplet are not independent linear multiplets in addition to Sigma. Top sector adds colour Weyl ttilde,ttilde^c giving an EW singlet vector-like quark of charge2/3.

locator.anchor: do not concern ourselves with cancellation

claims.value: Full product-group fermion U1 assignments are constrained to yield SM charges and invariant operators, but extra cutoff fermions cancelling broken-group anomalies are not specified. Do not replace this with a guessed UV spectrum or count a symmetric5x5 Sigma as an unconstrained complex15.

source_descriptions.reason: Numerical finite linear-irrep schema cannot encode the constrained sigma model plus boundary of unknown cutoff fermions. Source electroweak/colour top quantum numbers preserved, product U1 assignment not fabricated.
